additional_info.subject: ID0376517-DC/Si-D/FR[vcz9ks] - Error Code 37 CRM:00315001695
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien, good morning.
Thank you for your patience.
I have made the measurements on the points that I show below:
What we should measure is 24V in the output of the KF13 (CCS-B OUT (J2) TrO, when the CableCheck is performed and then go back to 0V just before the Pre-Charge as it's shown in the logs the Command = OFF, and then back to 24V on the Pre-Charge.
I am suspecting that the 24V are stuck and as such the contactors do not open, since the Command stays ON.
If you are able to do this task please perform this test. I will put myself in CC, in case you need any assistance. You can also schedule a Microsoft Teams meeting with me and we can align the time.
Let me know your thoughts.
Best regards,
Francisco
